test_scalar_parameter: test the parameter.Parameter class with a single-valued scalar parameter round-trips through vector conversion, sampling, and reset
test_vector_parameter: test the parameter.Parameter class with a multi-valued vector parameter preserves element-wise bounds and resets correctly
test_parameter_dict: test the parameter.ParameterDict class flattens mixed scalar and vector params into one vector and reconstructs individual values
test_save_and_load_round_trip: test the parameter.ParameterDict save_to_disk and load_from_disk methods recover modified values, nominals, and bounds from YAML
test_randomize_stays_in_bounds: test the parameter.ParameterDict randomize method keeps all randomized values within their declared bounds
